prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: a dense forest canopy seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE: tightly packed rounded tree crowns of different sizes, dark green with blue-violet shadows between crowns, each crown lit on its upper-left with leaf clusters. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square SEAMLESS TILEABLE top-down JRPG map ground texture of a dense forest canopy, directly overhead orthographic. Entire square filled edge to edge by tightly packed rounded tree crowns of varied sizes, no sky or ground visible; dark earthy green foliage, saturated blue-violet and reddish-purple narrow recesses between crowns. Each crown has distinct leaf-cluster highlights on upper-left edges, warm muted yellow-green highlights; calm neutral soft even upper-left ambient daylight, not dark. Premium hand-placed modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, clean large uniformly sized hard square pixels, consistent pixel grid, pixel clusters of 3–10 squares forming readable leaf shapes. Palette 4–6 hue-shifted shades per foliage material; organic rich earthy worn-in colors. Aim for approximately 256 by 256 ART pixels visually enlarged with perfectly crisp nearest-neighbor pixels, no antialiasing, blur, noise, gradients, soft brushes, checkerboard dithering, or photographic texture. Tile boundaries must match: foliage shapes, color, and inter-crown shadows leaving right boundary should continue at same vertical position at left boundary, and bottom at top. Even distribution of crowns and detail, no composition focal point, no frame, border, cast shadow, lighting pools, glow, vignette, characters, objects or lettering.
